ABOUT THE PRODUCT

Scouring Felt – Rolls and Sheets.

We produce scouring felt in our own plant and supply it in rolls, sheets or cut pieces to manufacturers of dish sponges, scouring pads and similar products.

The felts are produced in the ST and STA series in grammages from 250 g/m² to 1000 g/m². The number in the series code indicates the grammage: STA 55 is a 550 g/m² felt. The colours available in each grammage are shown in the table below.

The standard roll width is 1.02 m; a 2 m wide roll and 40 cm and 68 cm narrow rolls can also be supplied. Grammage, colour and size are agreed together according to your needs.

  • 250–1000 g/m² grammage
  • Nearly twenty colours
  • 1.02 m standard roll width
  • Sheets and cut pieces
